justification: Caleb's locked in from Thursday and he was never sitting anyway — that's not a decision, that's a given. Skattebo put the ball on the carpet in a loss last week, and ball security in a loss is a character issue in this building, talent or not, so he's benched on principle and Judkins steps into RB2 off a double-digit projection because that's a back who takes the top off a defense, not a committee arm. Jeanty stays the workhorse, Pollard holds the flex, Downs and Goedert keep their jobs because nobody beat them out, and Reichard and the Lions D round out a lineup that isn't broken. A.J. Brown is stuck on the bench this week whether I like it or not — his game kicked and finished Thursday before I ever touched this sheet, and I don't backdate a lineup to fix a swing I didn't make in the early window. We don't tank, we don't stream, we cobble together the best eleven standing and go beat Rinna's reunion special with it.
forum_post: Rinna — keep the invite, I'm not walking into any reunion, I'm walking into Sunday with the one quarterback in this building who doesn't need a séance to show up. Chase your forty-two-year-old rerun with the other two desperate GMs, I'll be over here benching a fumble and starting a back with a pulse. See you on the scoreboard.
